# Formal unreachability of toggle points: ot_gpio

Generated by `nnc sim --unr` (nnc/unr.py, no LLM). Each bit below had no recorded 1->0 toggle. SymbiYosys (`abc --keep-going pdr`) checked whether it can change after the first reset, for every input sequence (inputs free; the first reset held until every clock has had 2 rising edges). PROVEN bits are left out of the toggle coverage; the others stay counted. A counterexample uses free inputs, so it does not show that legal stimulus reaches the point. Every task also asserts that the checked phase is never reached; that guard must fail, else the task concludes nothing (its bits stay counted). A control assertion states the same property on a flop output that the simulation toggled many times; it must fail too, else the model does not match the simulation and the task concludes nothing.

RTL SHA-256 `920ff6a96ce25dbf...`
